summary: Give diffs theme-aware dark-mode tokens and pick readable remote cursor labels

diagnostics.message: No exact registry source file found for diff-colors.

entries.summary: Add `--editor-insert` with light and dark values and Tailwind colors `editor-insert` and `editor-delete` (falling back to `--destructive`).
migrationNotes: To customize insert colors, edit `--editor-insert` in `:root` and `.dark`. Delete colors follow `--destructive` unless you set `--editor-delete`. Re-adding `@plate/diff` or `@plate/diff-colors` alone keeps your edits.

entries.summary: Paint insert and delete panels, marks, titles, and property cards with `editor-insert` and `editor-delete` tokens, add dark-mode styling to warning and conflict cards, and remove the invalid `platejs/diff` package dependency.
migrationNotes: A `diff` component copied before this change keeps fixed emerald and red classes. Add `diff` again with `shadcn add --overwrite`, which replaces local edits to that file.

entries.summary: Style the comparison error banner with `destructive` and `foreground` tokens so it stays readable in dark mode.
Pick black or white cursor label text for whichever has higher contrast against each peer's color while keeping remote selections at 20 % opacity.
migrationNotes: A `remote-cursor-overlay` copied before this change always uses white label text. Add `remote-cursor-overlay` again with `shadcn add --overwrite`, which replaces local edits to that file.
